# Interface: FilesystemAccessor

Defined in: [src/core/result/filesystem.ts:12](https://github.com/jterrazz/package-test/blob/main/src/core/result/filesystem.ts#L12)

Read-only accessor for the whole temporary working directory used by a
command spec.

Assertions go through `expect()` (async — they walk the disk):
`await expect(result.filesystem).toMatch('scaffolded')` compares the
tree against the fixture directory `_expected/<name>/`.
